Winter_Garden.name: Crimson
Winter_Garden.description:
A bright, true blue-based red. Full-pigment colour in a velvety matte finish that stays put from morning to night.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a strong, deep olive-brown that stands out clearly against the skin.

The True Tone: It is a saturated, cool-leaning classic red. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 35% lightness (a rich mid-dark tone). It gives high contrast and makes the lips the focus.

Winter_Garden.name: Origin
Winter_Garden.description:
A warm peachy nude, close to a natural lip but a touch richer. Velvety matte with a soft, blurred look.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a light, warm tan or soft khaki.

The True Tone: It is a low-saturation peach beige with warm undertones. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 65% lightness (a light mid tone). It gives a subtle, low-contrast, your-lips-but-better effect.

Winter_Garden.name: Petal
Winter_Garden.description:
A soft baby pink with a fresh, clean feel. Velvety matte with full coverage.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a very light, slightly warm grey or pale beige.

The True Tone: It is a light, cool-leaning pastel pink. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 78% lightness (a bright, soft highlight tone). It gives a gentle lift without looking dark.

Winter_Garden.name: Dusk
Winter_Garden.description:
A dusty mauve rose with a hint of berry. Velvety matte, grown-up and easy to wear.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a muted, medium greyish blue-brown.

The True Tone: It is a low-saturation mauve with cool, slightly purple undertones. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 45% lightness (a mid tone). It gives moderate contrast with a soft, smoky feel.

Sun_Goddess.name: Danaya
Sun_Goddess.description:
A deep, classic red with a slight brick warmth. Smooth satin finish with a soft, natural sheen.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a deep olive-brown with good contrast against the skin.

The True Tone: It is a saturated, warm-leaning true red. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 33% lightness (a rich mid-dark tone). It gives a bold, high-contrast statement lip.

Sun_Goddess.name: Hasmin
Sun_Goddess.description:
A warm brick red with a brown, rusty edge. Smooth satin finish with a soft sheen.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a medium, muddy olive-brown.

The True Tone: It is a moderately saturated red-brown with warm undertones. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 42% lightness (a mid tone). It gives medium contrast and an earthy, autumn feel.

Sun_Goddess.name: Mahal
Sun_Goddess.description:
A burnt orange terracotta, warm and sun-kissed. Smooth satin finish with a soft sheen.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a warm mustard or golden brown.

The True Tone: It is a saturated orange-red with strong warm undertones. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 50% lightness (a mid tone). It gives a bright, warm pop of colour without going dark.

Sun_Goddess.name: Perena
Sun_Goddess.description:
A warm caramel beige nude. Smooth satin finish with a soft, natural sheen.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a light, warm sandy beige, very close to how it looks to most people.

The True Tone: It is a low-saturation beige with warm, slightly peachy undertones. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 62% lightness (a light mid tone). It gives a soft, low-contrast, polished nude.

Thorns_and_Roses.name: Yzeth
Thorns_and_Roses.description:
A crystal-clear gloss with no colour at all. High-shine and light-catching, worn alone or over any lipstick.

How it appears to you: This gloss reads as completely clear, the same as to everyone.

The True Tone: It is a transparent, colourless gloss. It adds shine without changing the colour underneath, so it suits every skin tone and works as a top coat.

Thorns_and_Roses.name: Lylia
Thorns_and_Roses.description:
A sheer mauve pink gloss with a soft wash of colour. High-shine and light-catching.

How it appears to you: This gloss reads as a sheer, light greyish blue or lilac.

The True Tone: It is a semi-sheer, cool-leaning mauve pink. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 60% lightness (a light mid tone). It gives a juicy, low-contrast tint.

Thorns_and_Roses.name: Amarantha
Thorns_and_Roses.description:
A coral copper gloss with fine golden shimmer. High-shine and light-catching.

How it appears to you: This gloss reads as a warm golden mustard with visible sparkle.

The True Tone: It is a semi-sheer, warm orange coral with gold shimmer. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 55% lightness (a mid tone). It gives a sunny, glowy lip with medium contrast.

Thorns_and_Roses.name: Thuy
Thorns_and_Roses.description:
A rose gold gloss packed with fine shimmer. High-shine and light-catching.

How it appears to you: This gloss reads as a light, warm beige-gold with visible sparkle.

The True Tone: It is a semi-sheer, warm pinky bronze with metallic shimmer. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 60% lightness (a light mid tone). It gives a soft, glowy, low-contrast shine.

Beaunds.name: Cardona
Beaunds.description:
A deep plum, almost blackberry. Smooth satin finish with a soft sheen.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a very dark navy or near-black.

The True Tone: It is a deep, cool purple-brown. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 15% lightness (a very dark tone). It gives maximum contrast and a moody, dramatic look.

Beaunds.name: Benesa
Beaunds.description:
A pale ballet pink, light and fresh. Smooth satin finish with a soft sheen.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a very light, warm off-white or pale beige.

The True Tone: It is a light, low-saturation pink with a hint of peach. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 82% lightness (a bright highlight tone). It gives a soft, barely-there lift.

Beaunds.name: Hillary
Beaunds.description:
A deep wine burgundy, rich and polished. Smooth satin finish with a soft sheen.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a very dark brown or deep olive.

The True Tone: It is a deep, cool-leaning red-purple. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 22% lightness (a dark tone). It gives high contrast and a classic, vampy feel.

Beaunds.name: Leigh
Beaunds.description:
A rosewood brown, a nude with a touch of brick rose. Smooth satin finish with a soft sheen.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a medium, muted khaki brown.

The True Tone: It is a low-saturation pinky brown with warm undertones. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 45% lightness (a mid tone). It gives a natural, everyday deeper nude.

Liexquizo.name: Chelsea
Liexquizo.description:
A raspberry berry red, between red and plum. Velvety matte with full coverage.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a medium-dark muddy blue-brown.

The True Tone: It is a moderately saturated berry with cool, purple-pink undertones. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 38% lightness (a mid-dark tone). It gives strong contrast with a softer edge than a true red.

Liexquizo.name: Solana
Liexquizo.description:
A near-black deep aubergine purple. Velvety matte, bold and edgy.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a very dark navy or near-black.

The True Tone: It is a deep, cool blue-purple. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 12% lightness (a near-black tone). It gives the highest contrast in the range and a full statement look.

Liexquizo.name: Migrana
Liexquizo.description:
A pale pinky nude, soft and creamy. Velvety matte with full coverage.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a very light, warm beige.

The True Tone: It is a light, low-saturation pink beige. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 76% lightness (a bright, soft tone). It gives a clean, low-contrast nude lip.

Liexquizo.name: Aotea
Liexquizo.description:
A deep cherry red with a cool blue base. Velvety matte with full coverage.

How it appears to you: This shade reads as a deep olive-brown with strong contrast.

The True Tone: It is a saturated, cool-leaning ruby red. On a grayscale from black to white, it sits at about 30% lightness (a rich mid-dark tone). It gives a bold, glamorous statement lip.
